content: Forever: item stats obfuscated until item drops for you or someone on your server (Greenfield, Warcraft Tavern 2026-09-16: 'first week will be the Wild West'). GDKP banned (Q&A 2026-09-17). Every boss has rare chase items (Zierhut, DST model). Tier sets datamined as crafted, role-split, cost Malleable Essence of Nature from disenchanting Barrow Deeps/Hyjal raid items; single crafted tier piece equippable at start (beta, unverified). Addon API mirrors Midnight; addon comms locked only during active encounter. Guild Order Loot Ledger offers SR/HR/DKP/EPGP for Forever, item data only after loot published.
